text:
anya (PM): quick thread on model catalog compare UX — main asks: make rows scannable, badge clarity, filter persistence behavior, and safer pin flow for prod. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/compare-mini

lucas (Design): current stacked badges create visual noise. proposal: compact row (56px) with name + small version pill on left, 3 micro-chips inline right (p95, tokens/sec, est cost). chips use number + tiny qualitative label, color banding. hover expands details.

noor (Eng): note on virtualization: fixed 56px rows are best. variable heights hurt performance. implementing inline chips is cheap; hover expansion can lazy-render.

rachel (Research): users prefer numeric p95 for precision and a small qualitative tag for glanceability. test idea: numeric-only vs numeric+label for time-to-decision and recall.

lucas (Design): pin affordance: inline lock icon on hover near version pill; persistent when pinned. keyboard shortcut "P" toggles pin for focused row; show toast. copy: "Pin this model version to the route (prevents automatic updates)".

anya (PM): product constraint: pinning on prod requires confirmation modal. non-prod no modal. also add analytics event for pin changes.

a11y-bot: accessibility checklist: pin button needs aria-pressed, aria-label, 32px hit target, focus-visible styles, and an sr-only status update when state changes. sort controls need aria-sort and larger hit targets. ensure contrast >= 3:1 for micro-chip text and 4.5:1 for focus outlines.

noor (Eng): filter persistence: plan = restore last-used filters per-user via localStorage, plus an explicit "Save as preset for this route" server-side. endpoints: /api/user/presets and /api/route/:id/presets. client merges local restore + route preset. ETA 3d.

lucas (Design): small copy tweaks: change tooltip "Pin version" -> "Pin this model version to the route (overrides model updates)"; badge hover header -> "Performance snapshot"; chips use sentence case.

anya (PM): action items: lucas -> push compact + expanded mocks with keyboard flows; noor -> confirm ETA and add presets endpoints; rachel -> write short A/B plan for badge format; i'll update PRD and schedule sync Friday 10am. Thanks!
